label: RPC_SystemConnectionStructure
info:
RPC Handler for SystemConnectionStructure
Methods:
- getSystemConnectionStructure (read)
- setSystemConnectionStructure (write + read)

name: Handle RPC
getSystemConnectionStructure / setSystemConnectionStructure
info:
Read/Write system connection structure:

Read-Only:
- 100: deviceType
- 103-107: Serial Number
- 114-118: Firmware versions
- 120-121: Rated power
- 202: battery capacity

R/W Registers:
- 282: gridStandardRaw [0-4]
- 283: gridFrequencyHz [0=50Hz,1=60Hz]
- 284: gridType [0-3]
- 238: gridVoltageLevelCode [0-4]
- 247: gridPhaseSequence [0-1]
- 211: batteryControlMode [0-2]
- 233: generator.inputMode [0-2]
- 289: generator.connectedToGridInput [0-1]
- 242: exportLimitMode [0-2]
